name: Clef
summary: Cloudflare's 27B decision model; reads text, JSON and images. Tops Jev on most of the card's Decision Index rows (vendor table). Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.
